about: motion research counter-example: a step-level sender, single-brace and camelCase placeholders, a default, a comment without a Contact variable, no on_reply

errors.rule: step-level by is not supported; use settings.assign
must be a duration between 14d and 180d: a number then m, h or d, like 30d
{FIRST_NAME} is not a variable; write {{contact.<field>}} or remove the braces
unknown variable {{firstName}}; use contact.<field>, contact.extra.<key>, account.first_name, account.last_name, account.full_name or motion.<key>
required because the text uses a variable
variable defaults are not supported; add a fallback
a comment must use a contact variable, such as {{contact.extra.comment}}
